split_method: sorted frozen dependency IDs, seeded permutation, four equal-count chunks
learning_tree_selection: highest median combined development OOF AP; ties choose random_forest
learning_sampling: nested seeded permutations of the twelve outer-training dependency groups; all 20 outer folds
permutation_scoring: held-out AP; within-event permutation primary, global-row permutation secondary
weather_near_equal: absolute difference <= 1% of development feature SD; descriptive only, not fitted preprocessing
storm_sensitivity: equal dependency weights at evaluation only; no refitting
uncertainty: descriptive repeated splits of the same 45 events, not independent replicates
